name: Flowscape Technology AB (publ)
summary: Based in Stockholm, Sweden, Flowscape Technology AB (publ) provides advanced workplace management solutions, primarily for the Swedish market. Their extensive service portfolio includes tools for desk and parking management, efficient room booking, comprehensive workplace analytics, a digital workplace platform, building messaging, a flow planner, and systems designed to measure workplace ROI and manage meeting room panels. To complement these offerings, their product line features hardware such as room displays, automatic desk check-in devices, 'busy' lights, interactive kiosk screens, and various sensor technologies. The company, founded in 2007, was formerly known as Crowdsoft Technology AB (publ) until its rebranding to Flowscape Technology AB (publ) in July 2018.
